DWARVES IN SPACE!

This game is a lot of fun. I definitely recommend it.

What a surprise this game has turned out to be! DRG is a co-op driven (but can be played solo!) mining game.

Fighting the darkness and an endless supply of bugs, you must navigate your way around highly impressive procedurally generated caves. Your objective is to gather either minerals or eggs (or kill some big baddies!), for reasons unknown. And honestly, when something is just plain enjoyable to play, you dont need a story! With a finite amount of ammo (and resupply), you need to pace yourself!

There is something almost therapeutic about digging your way around sometimes, and the cool [i]Stranger things[/i]-esque soundtrack doesnt hurt either. Capped off brilliantly with a climatic dash (against the clock and swarms of mobs) to the escape pod to finish your mission.

Classes all feel unique and are made to compliment each other (some stronger than others when solo). 

The game visually looks a lot like Astroneer. Not a surprise since they are both UE4 based, with terrain modifying as core mechanics. Its hardware req is modest, with a GTX970 being able to stay over 60fps with maxed settings in 1080p. A number of options available to tweak things for lesser hardware, frame rate cap, and a variety of audio sliders (always appreciated!) are available.

I bought it for €17 (25% off its current EA price tag), I feel I have gotten my moneysworth at that. With more content to come, I can easily say its worth the money. Depending on how much is added, it may be worth more (dont know what the price tag for full release will be).

The game is due to be in EA for approx 1 year (so a release Q1 2019 is the rough target). The roadmap includes
-A 5th class
-Boss
-More random mutators for maps
-More mobs
-More biomes

Cant wait! [b]ROCK AND STONE![/b]


*E: Monthly content is solid. Worth it at full price. Slightly concerned about the "5th class" slipping into a "maybe" pile tho :/

[h1]Update May2020[/h1]
We are days away from its official 1.0 launch and its been a long time since the 5th class has been mentioned. I did fear it was going to be quietly dropped (perhaps they will sell it as DLC, who knows.)

E: Nonsense update Nov2023 (for steam badge event, really). Still a great game! Look forward to the spin offs next year :)

The co-op of Left for Dead, the swarming bugs reminiscent of the Zerg from Starcraft and the bugs from Starship troopers, and the mining and cave delving like Minecraft. It is a perfectly made mincemeat of delicious game play with quality classess, a variety of difficulties, different biomes, and a bunch of monsters. With each difficulty of mission the more Zerg-like and brutal the swarms get.

There are a staggering variety of monsters, a decent arsenal of weapons and upgrades, as well as lots of combinations one can make with each class.

If co-op isn't your cup of tea there is a solo mode. However this game really hinges heavily on the multiplayer dynamic. Fortunately if you were like me and didn't have any friends who had the game, there are plenty of teams you can easily hot join for almost any difficulty. If you start your own lobby it'll probably fill up within minutes.

Great game, can play solo, or with randoms but it does shine better with friends. Price range is fair, with the current set up you'll get a good 30 hrs with just sticking to one class. To dumb it down its like Left for Dead but with an objective and classes. Get tossed into the core from space, survive in total darkness, toss pitty flares in hopes to find what you need, and get out without getting blown up, choked to death in toxic fumes, assulted by swarms or pulled into the ceiling by a cave leech. (♥♥♥♥ cave leeches) My only real gripe is with Big rock, they really need to invest in some better mining equipment.
